hooks.text: "Every night they come a little further up the road. Go down and make them start from the bottom again."
"Three of us saw them marching in step past the mounds. Somebody go and break step for them. We'll stand you a drink. One drink."
"Nobody buys lamp oil to go down there any more. Make the Barrows safe enough to be merely dangerous again."
"The Watch can't spare the men. The Watch can spare the coin, this once. Hold them in the Barrows. O. Hale."
"The dead we raise stay raised because someone keeps the others down. This week, let it be you."
"Standing job. Go down, stand your ground, come back up. The Guild pays by the fight, less the Guild's cut."

brief.one: Hold a wave in the Old Barrows
brief.many: Hold {n} waves in the Old Barrows

label: Waves held in the Old Barrows
journal: Go down into the Old Barrows and hold {n} waves against the dead there, in any rooms.
ready: Hand it in at the Lantern Guild's board, inside the Tired Mule in Thornwick.
done: The barrows road was quiet for a night or two.

hooks.text: "Nobody buys lamp oil to sit in the dark, and nobody sits in the dark with that lot about. Thin them out. Then buy oil."
"Fewer of them in {site} means more of you in here of an evening. We've thought about it, and we're for it."
"We pray for the dead of {site}. It would help if fewer of them were walking about while we did."
"The traps by {site} come up empty and chewed. Go and stand there a while. Loudly."
"Standing job, Saltmere rate: go in, hold the room, come back dry if you can. The Guild pays by the fight."
"I'll not pole past {site} after dark until somebody's been in and argued with them. Be that somebody."

fens.label: Waves held in {site}
fens.journal: Go into {site} and hold {n} waves there, in any rooms.
fens.ready: Hand it in at the Lantern Guild's board, inside the Drowned Eel in Saltmere.
fens.done: Saltmere slept a little better. The eels did not care either way.

hooks.text: "The moot has voted to pay somebody to stand in {site} and hit things. It took a week. Please make it worth the week."
"Fewer of them in {site}, more of you in here with a mug. I've done the sums. Bel."
"I count them going out. I'd like to count some coming back. Thin out {site} so they can."
"Standing job, Ashgate rate: go down, hold the room, come back with the soot on. The Guild pays by the fight."
"Go and blunt something in {site}. Then bring it to me. I like the work."
"There are boots by my door waiting for their owners. Go and make {site} a place a man could walk home from."

reach.label: Waves held in {site}
reach.journal: Go into {site} and hold {n} waves there, in any rooms.
reach.ready: Hand it in at the Lantern Guild's board, inside the Slag & Bellows in Ashgate.
reach.done: Ashgate slept a little better. The moot argued about whether it had.
